title: Boolean Masking in Pandas
text: In pandas, you can filter rows of a DataFrame by creating a boolean mask. A boolean mask is a Series of True/False values that correspond to each row in the DataFrame. When you apply this mask to the DataFrame, only the rows where the mask is True are returned.
